I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, when a vehicle coming straight through the
intersection struck the driver's side of my car. I had been waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic and had my turn signal

steering wheel and the pain was immediate; I was later told it was fractured. I have described what happened the
same way to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff, and to the adjuster, and I have no changes to add. I am
staying with the policyholder, who is my household member, and I drive their vehicle regularly with their permission. I
am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
